name: mageme/module-eu-withdrawal-hyva
description: Hyva theme compatibility for mageme/module-eu-withdrawal. Re-renders the customer-facing withdrawal form (4-step SPA + lookup) and order-view integrations using pure Alpine.js + Tailwind utilities — no KO, no jQuery, no Magewire dependency. Hyva checkout integration (precontract block + waiver step) is shipped separately. NOT legal advice — see README disclaimer.
